title: 7.2 Properties of Parallelograms

icans: I can use the sides and angles of a parallelogram to find missing measures.
I can use the fact that the diagonals of a parallelogram bisect each other.
I can find a missing vertex or the intersection of the diagonals in the coordinate plane.

vocab: a ________________ with both pairs of opposite sides parallel
angles at the two __________ of one side

blocks.p: Use the lines on graph paper to draw a parallelogram ABCD (two pairs of parallel sides). Draw both diagonals and label where they meet E. Measure.
Three things that are always true about a parallelogram:

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Parallelogram Opposite Sides Theorem: Opposite sides of a parallelogram are _______________.
Parallelogram Opposite Angles Theorem: Opposite angles of a parallelogram are _______________.
Parallelogram Consecutive Angles Theorem: Consecutive angles of a parallelogram are _______________ (they add to ______°).

blocks.stem: ABCD is a parallelogram. AB = 3x − 4, DC = 2x + 5, and m∠A = 70°. Find x, AB, m∠B, and m∠C.
In parallelogram PQRS, m∠P = (4y + 10)° and m∠Q = (2y + 20)°. Find y and both angles.

notes: Parallelogram Diagonals Theorem: The diagonals of a parallelogram _______________ each other.

blocks.stem: In parallelogram ABCD, the diagonals meet at E. AE = x + 7 and EC = 3x − 5. Find x and AC.
Three vertices of parallelogram JKLM are J(−1, 2), K(3, 4), and L(5, 0). Find the coordinates of M and of the point where the diagonals meet.
In parallelogram QRST, the diagonals meet at E. QE = 2y + 1 and ES = 4y − 9. Find y and QS.
In parallelogram PQRS, m∠P = (3x + 15)° and m∠R = (5x − 25)°. Find x, m∠P, and m∠Q.

tickets.stem: In parallelogram ABCD, AB = 5x − 8 and CD = 3x + 6. Find x and AB.
In parallelogram ABCD, m∠A = 58°. Find m∠B and m∠C.
Three vertices of parallelogram ABCD are A(0, 0), B(4, 0), and C(6, 3). Find D.
